question.text: A zero-coupon bond has face value Rs. 10,00,000 maturing in 10 years. The 10-year yield is 10%. What is its current price (to nearest rupee)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Price = FV/(1+r)^n = 10,00,000/(1.10)^10 = 10,00,000/2.5937 = 3,85,543.29 ≈ Rs. 3,85,543. The Trap: Rs. 9,09,091 uses 1-year discounting; Rs. 5,00,000 is half; Rs. 4,24,098 uses 9-year miscount. Cross-Exam Context: IV covers zero-coupon math; XXI-B uses for immunization.
